# Saleem Skin

> Award-winning aesthetic clinic in Manchester offering premium skin, health and wellness treatments by expert specialists.

Saleem Skin delivers advanced aesthetic treatments — including HydraFacial, injectables, PRP, skin rejuvenation and wellness therapies — at its Manchester clinic.
